question: In the bubbling fluidized bed, by what percentage did the measured NO emissions rise when the NH3 co-firing ratio went from 0 to 10% at a PA/SA ratio of 1:0?
rendered:
Document 1 contains the relevant information. 

The experiment was conducted using a BFB combustion apparatus under fluidized bed conditions at 1123 K. A diagram of the experimental equipment is presented in Figure 1.

The NH3 co-firing ratio, defined as the ratio of NH3 input to the total thermal input of coal and NH3, as expressed in eq 1, ranged from 0 to 20%: 

= × × + × × R m Q m Q m Q 100%

The experimental results indicated that NO emissions increased significantly from 169 to 308 ppm as RNH3 increased from 0 to 10% under a PA/SA ratio of 1:0.

The percentage increase is (308-169)/169 * 100% = 82.1%

The answer is 82.1%
